sys_ui_action.comments:
This UI action is used to trigger Manual Case and Bulk ID The UI Action is available only when the following conditions are satisfied: 1) Trade life cycle status is not Trade settled or Cancelled 2) Case type = No Open Case 3) Source system = GHSS 4) If there are of the below values in Business Process Stages table return true and no exisiting active cases available for the trade New manual Maintence Records are created
a) Confirm trade b) Put trade on hold c) Resume trade d) Settle trade e) Process trade cancellation f) Trade Amend 5) System property to Limit the availablity based on the source system - x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.triggerManualCaseAllowedSourceSystem
Script Include Involved: MSSCustodyBulkUtils Methods Used: evalBulkOptionSingleTrade() , createManualTradeBulkID()
sys_ui_action.name: Trigger Manual Case
